multi_hop_neighbors.edge: There was a case of industrial espionage involving GM and VW.
GM has initiated criminal investigations in Germany and the United States based on their suspicions of Mr. López and his team.
GM established grounds for suspicion of industrial espionage through the filing of affidavits from its employees.
The objective will be to determine if VW's project was copied from GM data essential if industrial espionage is to be proved.
